pc.notAllowed: Your account does not have access to the Price Checker.
pc.confirmTick: Tick the box confirming the amount has come in.
pc.rejectReason: Say why it doesn't work: the client will read this.
pc.ticketNumberShape: Each ticket is 3 airline digits + 10 document digits.
pc.noticeMessage: Write the message: the client is the one who will read it.
pc.unfreezeReason: Write why the chosen flight is being reverted, the client will read this.
pc.datesReason: Write why the dates are changing, the client will read this sentence.

confirm.illegal: The payment is already in a state that cannot be marked as paid.
confirm.mismatch: Payment confirmed: with an amount different from the one charged, recorded in the history.
confirm.done: Payment confirmed. The case is ready to issue.

pc.proofRejected: Proof rejected. The client can send another.
pc.paymentExpired: Payment link closed. The client sees the expired screen.

claim.hasOwner: This case already has an owner. To hand it to someone else, change the seller in the header.
claim.lostRace: Someone else claimed this case first. Reload the page.
claim.done: Case claimed. It was unowned for {waited}.

pay.missingEither: Enter the reference or the link for {field}.
pay.savedNotSent: Instructions saved. They have not been sent yet.
pay.sentAutoDue: Instructions sent to the client. The deadline is {due}: time sent plus {hours}h.
pay.savedAndSent: Instructions saved and sent to the client.
pay.alreadySent: Instructions saved. These had already been sent to the client.
pay.emailFailed: The instructions were saved, but the email was NOT sent: {reason}. The client still doesn't know how to pay, send them the link on WhatsApp or try sending again.

close.notIssued: A case can only be closed after the ticket is issued. A case that wasn't issued is cancelled, and that is a different action.
close.done: Case closed. It has left the work queues.

archive.migrationMissing: Migration 0023 must be applied to archive cases.
archive.done: Case archived. It is in the Closed filter.

reopen.adminOnly: Only an administrator can reopen a closed case.
reopen.done: Case reopened. It is back in the work queues.

issue.pdfFailed: The PDF was not generated ({reason}), use "Generate again" on the Issuance tab.
issue.emailSent: The client received the email with the PDF attached.
issue.emailFailed: The email to the client was not sent, see the Communications tab.

tickets.noneYet: This case has no generated ticket yet. Use “Generate ticket” before resending.
tickets.resent: Ticket {number} resent: the same document, not regenerated.

seller.notListed: That seller is not on the access list.

link.adminOnly: Only an administrator can revoke the link.
link.failed: Could not generate a new link.
link.done: New link generated. The old one no longer opens: send the new one to the client.

unfreeze.issued: This case is already issued. Changing flight is a reissue.
unfreeze.paid: The client has already paid for this flight. Changing it requires a refund, not stepping back.
unfreeze.done: The flight is no longer frozen and the client's choice has been undone.
unfreeze.draft: The proposal is in draft as R{revision}.

dates.returnBeforeDepart: The return cannot be before the departure.
dates.issued: This case is already issued. A date change is a reissue.
dates.paid: The client has already paid. Talk to them before changing the dates.
dates.unchanged: The dates are the same as those already in the request.
dates.draft: The proposal went back to draft as R{revision}.
dates.clientNotified: The client was notified by email.
dates.clientNotNotified: Could not notify the client by email, contact them on WhatsApp.

write.noPermission: You do not have permission to grant this profile at this partner.
write.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
write.needsOrganisation: This profile belongs to a ministry: choose it.
write.profileNotInPartner: This profile does not exist at this partner.
write.mismatch: The data does not match the chosen profile.

access.notManager: Your account does not manage users.
access.onlyAdminGrantsAdmin: Only a WeeFly Admin can grant the WeeFly Admin profile.
access.cannotGrant: You cannot grant this profile at this partner.
access.secretaryNeedsOrganisation: The secretary belongs to a ministry: choose it.
access.ownProfile: Your own profile must be changed by someone else with management access.
access.cannotSuspendSelf: You cannot suspend your own account.
access.suspended: Account suspended. Open sessions have been ended.
access.suspendedNoSession: Account suspended. There was no session to end (the person has not signed up yet).

invite.alreadyRegistered: this person already has an account, they sign in with their own password.

partners.slugShape: The address may only contain lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
partners.firstAdminEmail: The first administrator's email is missing.
partners.firstAdminName: The first administrator's name is missing.
partners.onlyAdminCreates: Only a WeeFly Admin can create partners.
partners.slugTaken: A partner with that address already exists.
partners.createdAccountFailed: Partner created, but the first account failed: {error}
partners.onlyAdminEdits: Only a WeeFly Admin can edit partners.
partners.onlyAdminSuspends: Only a WeeFly Admin can suspend partners.
partners.operatorNotSuspendable: The platform operator cannot be suspended.
partners.suspended: Partner suspended. Its accounts can no longer sign in and its links no longer open.
partners.slugReserved: That address is reserved by the platform. Choose another one.
partners.createdNoAdmin: Partner created. It has no admin account yet: create it under Users once you have the email.

type.logo: The logo must be PNG or SVG.
type.icon: The icon must be PNG or SVG.
type.share: The share image must be JPG or PNG.

tooBig.logo: The logo is larger than 2 MB.
tooBig.icon: The icon is larger than 2 MB.
tooBig.share: The share image is larger than 1 MB.

icon.small: The icon must be at least 512 × 512.
icon.unreadable: This icon could not be read.

share.unreadable: This image could not be read.

upload.failed: The file did not upload. Try again.

done.icon: Icon saved. The favicon and icons were generated.

pro.masterOnly: Only the master account validates accounts.
pro.slugShape: The company address only takes lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, 2 to 30 characters.
pro.alreadyApproved: This account has already been approved.
pro.slugTaken: A company with that address already exists.
pro.approved: Account approved. The approval email was sent.
pro.approvedEmailFailed: Account approved, but the email was not sent: {reason}
pro.onlyPendingRejected: Only a pending account can be rejected.
pro.rejected: Account rejected. The email with the reason was sent.
pro.rejectedEmailFailed: Account rejected, but the email was not sent: {reason}
pro.slugReserved: That address is reserved by the platform. Choose another one.
pro.alreadyConfirmed: This account's email is already confirmed.
pro.resendFailed: The confirmation email was not sent: {reason}
